mechanism: AF3-guided structure-preserving mixed-curvature quantisation: one joint E16 x H16 codeword per token, and the weight between the two halves of every (item, level) is a learned gate over that item's frozen local AF3 structure descriptor

frozen_inputs.split: TRAIN only; the validation and test splits and any future behaviour are never read
frozen_inputs.graph: the TRAIN co-occurrence graph: one row's history plus its target is a sequence, consecutive items are adjacent, the graph is made undirected, de-duplicated and binarised; the rebuild reproduces the frozen AF3 cache of issue #136 edge for edge
frozen_inputs.af3: AF3(u,v) = 4 - deg(u) - deg(v) + 3 |N(u) & N(v)| on the binary TRAIN graph
frozen_inputs.communities: Louvain on the TRAIN binary graph, resolution 1.0, seed 42; the measured partition has 6 communities, so cross-community means between those six blocks, not between small groups
frozen_inputs.probe_subgraph: 3072 item ids drawn once from the TRAIN graph's nodes (seed 42); the three auxiliary terms are estimated on every triangle and every edge this set induces, so one step covers 100% of those sets. A batch-induced selection was measured at 3.4 triangles per step on the 4x1024-recipe, which is why the fixed probe subgraph replaced it before the single run.

computations.name: local structure descriptor
computations.definition: s_i = [log(1+d_i), log(1 + 0.5 sum_{e incident to i} T_e), mean_e AF3(e), q90_e AF3(e) - q10_e AF3(e), |{e incident to i : T_e>0}| / d_i, 1 - that share, -sum_b p_b log p_b / log d_i, |{j in N(i) : label_j != label_i}| / d_i]; every dimension is z-scored with the TRAIN mean and standard deviation of its observed entries
computations.gradient: frozen; it is not differentiated and not learned

computations.name: undefined descriptor entries
computations.definition: a dimension that cannot be measured (a node outside the graph, or no incident edge, or a single neighbour for the entropy) is stored as NaN and flagged in the mask; the gate consumes 0.0 for a flagged entry, which after standardisation is the TRAIN population mean
computations.output: the same 8-vector for the gate, with the mask as evidence
computations.gradient: none: this is a routing rule, and its counts are written to the table manifest and to the run's train_start record

computations.name: per-level structure gate
computations.definition: alpha_{i,l} = sigmoid(W2_l . GELU(W1_l s_i + b1_l) + b2_l), one independent head per level; W2_l and b2_l start at zero, so alpha_{i,l} = sigmoid(0) = 1/2 exactly at initialisation, which is the frozen baseline's ALPHA_INITIAL
computations.gradient: d alpha / d s = alpha (1-alpha) W2 . (GELU'(W1 s + b1) * W1); the descriptor is frozen, so the only learned parameters are W1, b1, W2, b2

computations.name: gated mixed cost of a joint codeword
computations.definition: C_{ik}^(l) = 2 * [ alpha_{i,l} || rE_{i,l} - eE_k ||^2 + (1 - alpha_{i,l}) d_c(rH_{i,l}, eH_k)^2 / 4 ]
computations.gradient: differentiable in the residuals and in alpha; the discrete assignment built on top of it is not part of this surface

computations.name: assignment rule
computations.definition: the baseline's rule, unchanged: the first two levels take the nearest code, the last level takes the balanced Sinkhorn assignment in training; alpha enters the cost matrix only, and n o argmin replaces the balancing

computations.name: native residual update
computations.definition: rE_l = rE_{l-1} - sg(eE_k), rH_l = (-sg(eH_k)) (+) rH_{l-1}, right-nested Moebius addition; alpha decides which code is chosen, never what the residual update is
computations.gradient: only the chosen code is detached, so the encoder keeps its commitment path and the codebook is updated by its own term

computations.name: readout of a complete code
computations.definition: phi(q) = [qE, log_0(qH)], qE = sum_k eE_k, qH = eH_1 (+) (eH_2 (+) eH_3); the decoder reads phi(q) through the baseline's straight-through path
computations.gradient: the straight-through path is the baseline's; its backward is the identity on phi by construction

computations.name: assignment proxy (straight-through)
inputs: the level's own centring, epsilon and iteration count
computations.definition: h^(l) = one_hot(k_l) + (p^(l) - p^(l).detach()); k_l is the code the quantiser itself takes -- argmin(C) on levels 1 and 2, and argmax(plan) on level 3, where plan is the same centring, the same SK_EPSILON and the same iteration count, row-normalised; p^(1,2) = (1-S)*softmax(-centred(C)/T) + S/K with T = 2/64 = 0.03125 and S = 1e-3, and p^(3) = (1-S)*plan + S/K
computations.output: h^(l) of shape [items, 256]; its forward value is exactly the one-hot of the taken code
computations.gradient: d h / d C = d p / d C. T is derived: the centring fixes the logit span at 2, so T = 2/64 keeps every exponent inside float32 both ways (exp(-32) = 1.3e-14) and no entry underflows. S is derived: a sharp softmax rounds its maximum to exactly 1.0 in float32 once the off-mass falls below the format's resolution near one (~1e-7), and such a row would have no derivative; S = 1e-3 bounds the maximum by 1 - S(1-1/K) and leaves four decades of margin. The uniform floor does not move the argmax, so k_l is untouched.
computations.measured: on the real probe pass with three random gate draws: no row has zero gradient on any level; median |dL/dC| = 1.5e-4 / 8.5e-5 / 3.1e-6 for levels 1/2/3 and median |dL/dalpha| = 4.5e-4 / 4.7e-4 / 1.3e-5; the carrier's argmax equals the taken code on 100% of rows on all three levels; L_closure reaches 0.00 and 1.00 on real cost matrices when the hard codes are made all-equal and all-distinct

computations.name: closure term
computations.definition: L_closure = 1 - mean_{triangles} mean_{(i,j) in triangle} (1/3) sum_l <h_i^(l), h_j^(l)>
computations.gradient: differentiable in the proxy's carrier; the value is exact token equality, because h is one-hot in the forward pass

computations.name: bridge term
computations.definition: L_bridge = relu( mean_{within-community edges} (1 - overlap) - mean_{cross-community edges} (1 - overlap) ), overlap(i,j) = (1/3) sum_l <h_i^(l), h_j^(l)>
computations.gradient: differentiable in q; a cross-community edge is never treated as a negative sample, the term only asks that its dissimilarity exceed a within-community edge's

computations.name: usage term
computations.definition: L_usage = (1/3) sum_l (1 - H(p_l) / log 256), p_l = mean_i h_i^(l); the value is the entropy deficit of the taken codes and the gradient comes from the carrier
computations.gradient: differentiable in q; it is the entropy deficit of the soft code usage, so a collapsing codebook raises it

computations.name: training objective
computations.definition: L = L_RQ + L_closure + L_bridge + L_usage, with L_RQ the baseline's reconstruction + quantisation term and all three weights equal to one; the three structural terms are measured on the fixed probe subgraph (coverage 1.0) and their own quantisation loss is not added
computations.output: the scalar the optimiser steps on
computations.gradient: the same scalar carries the gate parameters, the encoder, the codebooks and the decoder

switches.BEHAVIOR_OFF: the gate reads the frozen TRAIN-mean descriptor (the zero row after standardisation), so alpha_{i,l} = sigmoid(f_l(0)) does not depend on the item; the wiring check is that every item of a batch gets one identical alpha per level
switches.GEOMETRY_OFF: c = 0, so d_0^2 / 4 equals the squared Euclidean distance (numerically to 1e-6) and the hyperbolic half degenerates; the gate is unchanged
switches.BOTH_ON: the factory configuration of model/structure_gate.py: structure gate + c = 1

coupling.path: TRAIN graph AF3 local structure s_i -> gate alpha_{i,l} -> mixed cost C_{ijk}^(l) -> Sinkhorn / nearest-code assignment on the same cost -> residual recursion -> three-token SID -> reconstruction and the three structural terms
coupling.behaviour_side: replacing s_i by the frozen mean (BEHAVIOR_OFF) changes alpha, the cost matrix, the chosen codes and the loss on the same batch
coupling.geometry_side: c = 0 removes the curved half's contribution, so the same codes are scored differently and the assignment can change
coupling.not_in_the_path: no second, independent loss carries the behaviour signal: the descriptor reaches the assignment through the cost matrix, and the three structural terms are additional supervision on the same soft assignments

excluded.surface: the chosen index k_l = argmin_k C^(l) on the first two levels and the signed Sinkhorn argmax on the last
excluded.reason: discrete: the assignment rule is the baseline's and carries no gradient

excluded.surface: the re-centring max/min inside the soft assignment approximation
excluded.reason: piecewise differentiable with respect to the batch; the approximation is supervision only and never produces the SID

excluded.surface: the residual update rE - sg(eE) and (-sg(eH)) (+) rH
excluded.reason: the detach is a routing decision, not a derivative of the forward value

excluded.surface: the decoder straight-through path z + sg(phi(q) - z)
excluded.reason: its backward is the identity on phi by construction

excluded.surface: the structure descriptor, the AF3 values, the triangle counts and the community labels
excluded.reason: computed once on the frozen TRAIN graph and read as a constant; they are not parameters and have no derivative

excluded.surface: the frozen triangle and edge samples
excluded.reason: a deterministic seeded sample, frozen before training; only its members that happen to be in the batch enter a step, and the coverage is recorded

excluded.surface: the gate's hidden width, the equal lambda weights and the unit temperature
excluded.reason: design constants fixed before the single run, not fitted: two cells per descriptor dimension, three terms that already lie in [0,1], and the scale the baseline's centring leaves behind

excluded.surface: the straight-through residual p - p.detach() and the choice T = 2/64, S = 1e-3
excluded.reason: the residual is the surrogate derivative, not the derivative of the hard assignment; T and S are derived from the centring's span and float32's resolution near one, and are fixed before the single run

excluded.surface: the balanced plan's column normalisation, used as level 3's carrier
excluded.reason: it is differentiable and carried written out (sinkhorn_plan), but its backward is the derivative of an iterative normalisation, not of a closed form
